versions.content: Notify applications about the start or restart of an operation cycle Description: Interested monitoring application shall be informed about the start or restart of operation cycles. Rationale: Monitor reinitialization can be triggered by the start of an operation cycle. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: A monitor application gets initialized after diagnostic in AUTOSAR informs it about the start of a relevant operation cycle.
